# Sol-Luna Local Parallel

> Coordinate Sol-led, Luna-parallel work for non-overlapping local tasks.

## Primary instructions

- SKILL.md: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/sol-luna-local-parallel/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Installation: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/sol-luna-local-parallel/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Update: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/sol-luna-local-parallel/blob/main/docs/update.md

## Install

`npx skills add Fable-Forge/sol-luna-local-parallel`
